name: ado-mcp-server
description: Work items, test plans, repos and pipelines from Azure DevOps Server (on-premises) or Azure DevOps Services, with read-only by default.
long_description:
Connects Claude to Azure DevOps with your own Personal Access Token, so you only see what your account can see.

**Access levels**
- `read` (default): search and read only
- `write`: create and update work items, bugs, test cases, links, comments, run pipelines
- `full`: also deletes

Tools above the chosen level are not loaded at all. Every write tool first returns a preview and changes nothing until called again after your approval.

pat.title: Personal Access Token
pat.description: Your own PAT. Read scopes are enough for 'read'; 'write'/'full' need Read & Write on Work Items and Test Management.

default_project.title: Default project (optional)
default_project.description: Used when a request does not name a project.

access_level.title: Access level: read, write or full
access_level.description: read = read only (recommended). write = create/update work items, comments, links, run pipelines. full = also deletes.

api_version.title: API version
api_version.description: 7.0 for Server 2022 and cloud, 6.0 for Server 2020, 5.0 for Server 2019.

ignore_proxy.title: Ignore system proxy
ignore_proxy.description: Turn on if the server is on your internal network and a proxy/VPN app causes timeouts.

verify_ssl.title: Verify SSL certificate
verify_ssl.description: Turn off only for testing with a self-signed certificate; prefer setting a CA certificate file.

ca_bundle.title: Company CA certificate (optional)
ca_bundle.description: A .pem file if your server uses a certificate from an internal CA.
